items.problem: PointerPoint.PointerDevice property removed in WinUI 3 — replaced by direct PointerDeviceType property
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl line ~1050: 'Microsoft.UI.Input.PointerPoint doesn't have PointerDevice - it has PointerDeviceType directly'; CS1061 error in 2-PointerPointProperties.xaml.cs causing second build failure
items.skill_search: Grepped for 'PointerDevice' and 'PointerDeviceType' in winui-uwp-migration skill — no matches found
items.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md lists the namespace move (Windows.UI.Input → Microsoft.UI.Input) but does not document that PointerPoint's API surface changed: the .PointerDevice sub-object was removed and .PointerDeviceType became a direct property on PointerPoint
items.proposed_fix: Add a subsection under Namespace Mapping or a new 'API shape changes after namespace rewrite' section in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md documenting: `pointerPoint.PointerDevice.PointerDeviceType` → `pointerPoint.PointerDeviceType` (WinUI 3 flattened this property). Also note that PointerPoint.Properties is now accessed differently.
items.generalizes: Any UWP app using pointer input (common in drawing, gesture, and touch-heavy samples) will hit this. The PointerPoint API surface change affects all code that checks device type for input routing (mouse vs touch vs pen).
